positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description: As a Lead Software Engineer, I led the development of large-scale progressive web applications from early architecture and prototyping through production launch and continuous improvement. I partnered closely with product, design, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable solutions that improved both user experience and operational efficiency, while also mentoring engineers through technical guidance, code reviews, and collaboration. Some of the work I’m most proud of includes redesigning the onboarding experience to reduce registration time by over 20%, leading initiatives like Attendee Bridge and One-Click Registration, and helping expand the platform through Onsite experiences, shared component systems, API integrations, and standardized analytics across products.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: As a Software Engineer, I built internal automation tools and reporting pipelines that streamlined operations and reduced manual workflows, including Puppeteer-based archival systems, Google Apps Script reporting pipelines, and internal dashboards. I designed systems for algorithmic content translation from spreadsheet data sources, enabling automated event listings, multilingual content, and dynamic add-to-calendar functionality. I also developed reusable templates for conferences, listings, abstracts, and pre-conference experiences, improving deployment speed and consistency across client projects.
